question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Vertical
solution: The correct answer is '**Upright**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Vertical**' is '**Upright**'. • **Vertical**: going straight up at an angle of 90 degrees from the ground. (खड़ा, सीधा, लंबवत, अनुलंब) • *Example: a **vertical** line...* • **Upright**: in or into a vertical position. (खड़ी स्थिति में, खड़ा, सीधा) • *Example: I was so tired I could hardly stay **upright**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Upright.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Parallel**: (used about two lines, etc.) with the same distance between them for all their length. [(दो रेखाओं के संबंध में) समानांतर] • **Equal**: the same in size, amount, value, number, level, etc. [(आकार, मात्रा, मोल संख्‍या आदि की दृष्टि से) बराबर, समान] • **Shaky**: shaking or feeling weak because you are frightened or ill. [(डर या बीमारी के कारण) काँपता हुआ या कमज़ोरी अनुभव करता हुआ] 3f:T5cd, The correct answer is** 'No substitution required'.**
